title: Qu'est-ce qu'un texte?
oneGoal: Students identify different types of texts around them
progression: Foundation lesson - introduces the concept of texts everywhere
realWorldConnection: Texts are all around us - signs, books, labels, messages

title: Images parlent aussi
oneGoal: Students understand that pictures give information just like words
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by showing that texts include pictures that tell stories
realWorldConnection: Pictures help us understand when we can't read all the words

title: Prédire avec les images
oneGoal: Students make predictions about stories using cover pictures
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by using pictures to guess what might happen
realWorldConnection: We guess what might happen based on clues we see

title: Écouter et découvrir
oneGoal: Students listen to a simple story and check their predictions
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by checking if predictions were right
realWorldConnection: Sometimes our guesses are right, sometimes we learn something new

title: Reconter ensemble
oneGoal: Students retell story parts using simple words and gestures
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by retelling what they heard
realWorldConnection: We tell family about stories and movies we enjoyed

title: Textes différents partout
oneGoal: Students explore different types of texts (signs, lists, letters)
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by discovering that not all texts are stories
realWorldConnection: Different texts help us in different ways - signs, shopping lists, messages

title: Lire les indices
oneGoal: Students use context clues to understand unfamiliar words
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by learning strategies for unknown words
realWorldConnection: We figure out new words by looking at pictures and other clues

title: Questions importantes
oneGoal: Students ask 'who, what, where' questions about texts
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by actively questioning texts for understanding
realWorldConnection: Asking questions helps us understand better

title: Mes livres préférés
oneGoal: Students share favorite books and explain why they like them
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by expressing personal preferences about texts
realWorldConnection: Everyone has different favorite books and stories

title: Comparer les histoires
oneGoal: Students compare two simple stories and find similarities/differences
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by analyzing relationships between texts
realWorldConnection: Some stories are similar to our own experiences

title: Textes informatifs
oneGoal: Students explore non-fiction texts about familiar topics
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by distinguishing fiction from non-fiction
realWorldConnection: Some books teach us true facts about the world

title: Lire ensemble fort
oneGoal: Students participate in shared reading with expression
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by practicing reading skills together
realWorldConnection: Reading aloud helps us understand and enjoy stories more

title: Création de questions
oneGoal: Students create their own questions about a familiar text
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by becoming active questioners of texts
realWorldConnection: Good readers ask questions to understand better

title: Portfolio de lecture
oneGoal: Students compile favorite texts and explain their reading journey
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by reflecting on learning and growth
realWorldConnection: We can look back and see how much we've learned

title: Explorateurs de genres
oneGoal: Students explore poetry, fairy tales, and other genres through play
progression: Extension - applies text exploration skills to new genres
realWorldConnection: There are many different kinds of stories and texts to enjoy

title: Détectives de mots
oneGoal: Students hunt for familiar words in new texts
progression: Extension - deepens word recognition skills through games
realWorldConnection: Finding words we know helps us read new things

title: Théâtre des histoires
oneGoal: Students act out favorite stories to show comprehension
progression: Extension - demonstrates understanding through creative expression
realWorldConnection: Acting out stories helps us understand characters and events

title: Bibliothécaires experts
oneGoal: Students recommend books to classmates based on interests
progression: Extension - uses text knowledge to help others
realWorldConnection: Librarians and friends help us find books we'll enjoy

title: Textes de chez nous
oneGoal: Students explore texts from their own cultures and families
progression: Extension - connects text exploration to personal identity
realWorldConnection: Every family and culture has special stories and texts

title: Célébration de lecteurs
oneGoal: Students celebrate their growth as text explorers and readers
progression: Extension - culminates unit with reflection on reading journey
realWorldConnection: Readers celebrate discovering new worlds through texts
